articles.title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.03340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed LLM-agent teams can read the latest shared facts and still act on an obsolete plan. A planner may derive an action from requirement $r_3$, another agent may commit $r_4$, and an executor may receive $r_4$ without replacing the plan derived from $r_3$.
